column1: # Lines starting with # are comments. Blank lines are ignored.
# This file is the source of truth for lexical modernization until a final
# Bible translation version is settled. Context rules that are not simple
# word pairs (currently the verb "art" -> "are") stay in the Python script.
# Edit this file in the browser or locally; CI rebuilds REPLACEMENTS.md
# remaining -eth verbs: explicit 3rd-person forms, checked by hand (alphabetical).
# Proper names (Nazareth, Japheth...), Psalm 119 letters (BETH, CHETH, DALETH, TETH), -ieth ordinals and teeth are left out on purpose.
